app_dir.description: Folder of the application inside its own repository (template mode), e.g. backend or tools/pgadmin. .env, env_file, and compose.override.yaml resolve from here. Empty means the repository root.

build.description: Build policy for this app: allowed or forbidden.

compose_path.description: Compose file inside the app repository. Mutually exclusive with template.

cpu_limit.description: Declared CPU limit for this app (e.g. 0.5). Counted against the tenant cpu_limit when set.

critical.description: When true and the tenant failure_policy is stop, siblings are stopped if this app stays unhealthy past critical_grace.

depends_on.description: Other app names on this host that must reach synced before this registration applies.

deploy_key_file.description: Path to the SSH deploy key for repo_auth_method deploy_key.

env_files.description: External env files on the host whose changes trigger reconciliation.

failure_policy.description: Optional override of the tenant failure_policy for this app.

health_timeout.description: How long to wait for containers to become healthy, e.g. 45s.

memory_limit.description: Declared memory limit for this app (e.g. 512m). Counted against the tenant memory_limit when set.

name.description: Application name, unique on the host.

oneshot_timeout.description: Timeout for one-shot services, e.g. DB migrations.

pipeline_ref.description: Git ref whose pipeline gates deployment.

priority.description: Queue priority for this app (higher runs first).

project.description: Explicit Compose project name (adopts a pre-existing stack).

prune_volumes.description: Prune named volumes when the app is removed.

public_vars.description: Vars safe to show in status output.

pull_timeout.description: Timeout for image pulls of this app.

reconcile_interval.description: Reconcile interval for this app, e.g. 5m.

repo_auth_method.description: Repository auth: public, token, or deploy_key.

require_digest.description: Require @sha256 image digest pinning for this app.

require_pipeline_sources.description: Pipeline sources that gate this app.

require_pipeline_success.description: Require a green CI pipeline for the deployed commit.

required_jobs.description: CI jobs that must succeed for this app.

retry_rejected.description: Retry policy for rejected commits of this app.

revision.description: Pinned tag or commit SHA; overrides branch tracking.

shared_required_jobs.description: Required CI jobs shared with other apps from the same repository.

strict_pipeline_gate.description: Strict CI gate for this app.

suspended.description: Fleet-level pause: keep the app registered but do not deploy.

sync_timeout.description: Timeout for one sync of this app.

template.description: Fleet template name: templates/<template>/compose.yaml from the fleet checkout, merged with the app's compose.override.yaml. Mutually exclusive with compose_path.

tenant.description: Tenant this app belongs to (see tenants).

trusted_web_pipelines.description: Acceptance rules for manual (web) pipelines for this app.

vars.description: Compose interpolation variables for this app.

watch_files.description: Files watched for in-place reload instead of recreate.

service.description: Compose service the exception applies to.

cpu_limit.description: Declared CPU budget for the tenant (e.g. 2.0). Used to refuse new applies that would exceed the sum of app limits.

critical_grace.description: Grace period before stop policy halts sibling apps, e.g. 5m.

failure_policy.description: When an app fails reconcile: isolate (default), hold (freeze tenant updates), or stop (stop siblings after critical grace).

memory_limit.description: Declared memory budget for the tenant (e.g. 4g). Used to refuse new applies that would exceed the sum of app limits.

required_jobs.description: CI jobs that must succeed for apps of this tenant.

shared_required_jobs.description: Required CI jobs shared across the tenant's apps.

trusted_web_pipelines.description: Acceptance rules for manual (web) pipelines for this tenant.

allowed_users.description: GitLab users allowed to start trusted web pipelines.

allowed_variables.description: Pipeline variables allowed on trusted web pipelines.

enabled.description: Accept manual (web) pipelines when they satisfy the rules below.

required_jobs.description: CI jobs that must succeed on a trusted web pipeline.

path.description: Path inside the app checkout to watch.

reload_command.description: Command executed in the container on reload, e.g. kill -HUP 1.

description: Applications that should run on one host, declared in hosts/<fqdn>.yaml of a fleet repository. Generated from the Tide fleet parser structs; do not edit by hand.

$schema.description: URL of the published JSON Schema for this document, e.g. https://github.com/valthaide/tide/releases/download/v2.3.0/host.schema.json. Used by editors; Tide only checks it is a known field.

apps.description: Applications that should run on this host.

build.description: Host build policy: allowed or forbidden. Inherited by apps.

create_volumes.description: Allow Tide to create missing external Docker volumes.

host.description: Hostname (FQDN) this file describes. Defaults to the controller host when empty.

priority.description: Default queue priority inherited by apps (higher runs first).

reconcile_concurrency.description: Max concurrent stack applies on this host.

require_digest.description: Require @sha256 image digest pinning for all apps on this host.

require_pipeline_sources.description: Pipeline sources that gate deployments, inherited by apps.

retry_rejected.description: Retry policy for rejected commits: never, on_new_commit, or interval like 30m.

schema.description: Fleet format version. Supported version: 1. Omit to use the default. Unknown or newer versions are rejected.

shared_required_jobs.description: Required CI jobs shared by all apps on this host.

strict_pipeline_gate.description: Strict CI gate: absence of a trusted pipeline holds deployment.

tenants.description: Per-tenant CI gate rules, keyed by tenant name.

trusted_web_pipelines.description: Acceptance rules for manual (web) pipelines, inherited by apps.

volume_name_pattern.description: Regex external volume names must match when create_volumes is on.
